settings.aiPromptCriteria: Friendly, warm, and playful AI Referee. High-spirited, encouraging 1-2 sentence description celebrating family members and awarding bonus points for reunion spirit!

items.title: Hunting Season Chores
items.description: As a young boy, Grandpa Grant stayed home to milk cows during deer hunting season. Take a picture with cows in the background.

items.title: SanPete Gold Hunt
items.description: Grandpa Grant loved to prospect for gold and found low-grade ore in SanPete County. Take a picture by the FFA gate with a big rock.

items.title: 1000-Mile Thumb
items.description: After Army basic training, Grandpa Grant hitchhiked over 1000 miles to get home. Take a picture thumbing for a ride at the ATV parking area.

items.title: Quarry Boom
items.description: Grandma Marcia hated blasting at the picture rock quarry and cried until John came back into view. Take a picture with your fingers in your ears behind cabin 3.

items.title: Ditch Crew
items.description: Grandma Marcia helped change irrigation water by moving the dam and directing water with a shovel. Take a picture with the shovel at the creek by the bridge.

items.title: Fireplace Mouse Watch
items.description: Grandma Marcia was not afraid of mice and the family watched one explore the fireplace wall. Take a picture holding the mouse by the tail at the side of cabin 4.

items.title: Fort Ord Payday
items.description: Grandpa Grant served at Fort Ord as company clerk and lent money at high interest. Take a picture at the welcome kiosk holding some money.

items.title: Rawlins Recovery Run
items.description: Grandpa Grant was a truck driver and once had appendix surgery in Rawlins, Wyoming during a trip. Take a picture with one of the trucks in the parking lot.

items.title: Front Hall Book Time
items.description: Grandma Marcia read to her children nearly every day and taught a love of reading. Take a picture in front of the rec hall holding a book.

items.title: Provo Pin
items.description: Grandpa Grant pinned the best wrestler on the team twice and later took second at Utah state. Take a picture of wrestling in the rec hall.

items.title: Dummy Drop Dash
items.description: Grandpa Grant and Dick dropped a dummy near Harmon Park, then ran from police and snuck home. Take a picture by the big tree next to the entry road.

items.title: Overalls Forever
items.description: Grandpa Grant always wore overalls and even wore them to tease Paula at Kirk and Paula's wedding. Take a picture with the overalls at the water spigot by the bathroom.

items.title: 18 Wheeler Champion
items.description: Grandpa Grant won the National 18 Wheeler Rodeo in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Take a picture by the trailer next to cabin 1.

items.title: Rec Hall Cheer
items.description: Grandma Marcia was a high school cheerleader. Take a picture at the side of the rec hall cheering for the team.

items.title: Salutatorian Spotlight
items.description: Grandma Marcia graduated as salutatorian of Tooele High School. Take a picture receiving a diploma at the flagpole.

items.title: Brick Builder
items.description: Grandma Marcia carried bricks while pregnant with Kirk during the Orem home build. Take a picture by the bathroom with an armload of rocks.

items.title: Fire Escape Story
items.description: Grandma Marcia was trapped in a burning car after being rear-ended until John Roach broke the window and pulled her out. Take a picture by the fire pit.

items.title: Wedding Dress Maker
items.description: Grandma Marcia was an amazing seamstress who designed and sewed her own wedding dress and winter coats. Take a picture of the group holding the picture near the kitchen.
